ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
